# Architecture

<!-- codeforge:local-only:start -->

Section 3 · Architecture

Parent page: [Cognitive Workspace](../0-home/home.md)

<!-- codeforge:local-only:end -->

<!-- codeforge:body:start (testo scrivibile: e' la sorgente pubblicata su Confluence) seed:1cbbdc0bf6d9e110 -->
This section presents the system from the top: first an overview of how the ten domains relate, then one chapter per domain with its intent, boundaries and entry points, and finally the index of design decisions computed from the solution studies. Chapters are ordered from cross-cutting foundations (security, authentication) through the people-facing domains (contacts, volunteers), then the two generic modules (checklists and attachments), then the domains that consume them (device requests, shipments, special projects), and finally platform operations. No approved project plan exists yet, so this order is a reading proposal rather than a delivery sequence.
